paper_title: Limits on Axion Couplings from the first 80-day data of PandaX-II Experiment
coupling_convention: canonical g_Ae (axion-electron coupling), dimensionless, as plotted on Fig. 3 y-axis
notes: Paper reports three limits: (1) galactic ALP dark matter: gAe <~ 4e-13 (90% CL) roughly flat over 1-25 keV/c^2 (assumes local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3) - this is the limit encoded in data_points as a two-point flat bound (1 keV = 1e3 eV to 25 keV = 2.5e4 eV); actual curve varies, weakened near 4-6 keV due to 127Xe background, no numerical table available. (2) Solar CBRD axion: gAe < 4.35e-12 for 1e-5 to 1 keV/c^2 (not a DM-density-dependent bound). (3) 57Fe 14.4 keV solar axion: best limit gAe = 6e-14 at mA = 10 keV/c^2. Note: paper text contains internal typos (summary quotes 4.35e-11 and 4.3e-14, abstract/body quote 4.35e-12 and ~4e-13); abstract values used.
